name: PinCode
description: Multi-digit code input with auto-advance between fields. Each input accepts a single digit character. Supports paste distribution, backspace navigation, and masked display for password/PIN scenarios.

keyboardInteraction: Digit keys to enter a value and auto-advance
Backspace to clear current or move to previous
Paste to distribute digits across inputs
ariaAttributes: aria-invalid (on inputs when error is true)
notes: Container has role='group' with aria-label='Pin code input'.
Each input has an aria-label like 'Digit 1 of 4' for screen reader context.
Error state is communicated via aria-invalid on each input.
inputMode='numeric' ensures mobile devices show a numeric keyboard.
First input has autocomplete='one-time-code' for SMS autofill support.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus) and a 2px offset.

error.description: Shows error state with red border.

size.description: Size variant controlling input dimensions. Matches Button square sizes.

mask.description: Shows dots instead of digits (for passwords).

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the outer wrapper.

do: Use for verification codes, PINs, and one-time passwords.
Set mask=true when the input is a secret (e.g. PIN entry).
Pair with a visible label to clarify what code is expected.
dont: Do not use for general text input — use Input instead.
Do not use for credit card numbers — use a formatted Input instead.
Do not omit a label — if a visible label is not possible, provide aria-label on the container.
